description: Gamma is an AI content creation platform for building presentations, documents, websites, and social posts. It also supports workspace search, editing, export, comments, and analytics for Gamma content.
summary: Gamma exposes a REST API at `public-api.gamma.app/v1.0` authenticated by API key or OAuth 2.0 Bearer tokens, plus a hosted OAuth-protected MCP server at `https://mcp.gamma.app/mcp`; no Gamma CLI or GraphQL API was found.
